notablePrerequisites:
At least five creatures have died this turn.
Lagomos does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lagomos by tapping it, searching your library for Hostility and putting it into your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Hostility, targeting Lagomos.
Hostility triggers, shuflling it from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Mind over Matter trigger, untapping Lagomos.
Repeat.
